# Characters

## Alory Vane
- Voice: clipped, measured, numbers before feelings; professional register under pressure
- Drives: truth over comfort; finishing Therin's survey; proving the land moved
- Avoids: charity, false certainty, accepting the Guild's version

## Elara Venn
- Voice: calm, conceding surface control, threat through courtesy rather than volume
- Drives: protecting the Guild's version of the north; keeping Alory inside the fold
- Avoids: direct threats, explaining motives, names of dead colleagues
